expectations.text: Classifies copper as a Group II pollutant (toxic metal) with a technical review criterion of 1.2x the limit (20% over)
Concludes 25% over in 2 of 6 months MEETS the TRC, so the effluent criterion for SNC is met
expectations.evidence: Concludes TRC met, but via an invented "33% of measurements" test rather than 2+ months in 6

expectations.text: Notes the chronic criterion (4 of 6 months) is not met by two months
Says the DMR filed 45 days late is a reporting violation that can independently count toward SNC (30+ days late)
States that SNC status is assigned by EPA/the state and the permittee's own reading is indicative
expectations.evidence: Does not say SNC is assigned by EPA/state or that the permittee reading is indicative; only "verify against current text"
